commands.name: install
commands.description: Install a plugin from the EAC plugin catalog, a local path, HTTP package URL, or NuGet package ID.

options.name: --path
options.description: Plugin .dll, .nupkg, build output directory, or HTTP .nupkg URL.

options.name: --package
options.description: Plugin package id/name. Install accepts catalog identities and nupkg-style names with embedded versions.

options.name: --version
options.description: Plugin package version. Catalog installs default to the latest catalog version.

options.name: --service
options.description: EAC plugin catalog service id or name. Defaults to plugins.

options.name: --nuget
options.description: Resolve --package from nuget.org instead of the EAC plugin catalog. [default: False]

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Workspace path for repo-scoped plugin manifests.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Plugin install scope: repo or global. [default: repo]

options.name: --alias
options.description: Activate this plugin command alias instead of the plugin default alias.

options.name: --no-alias
options.description: Install the plugin without activating any CLI alias. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or text. [default: json]
